blind.description: A modular section of a conservatory or greenhouse wall. The bottom section consists of a low red-brick wall base. Resting on this base is a thick sill supporting a large multi-pane window with a light peach/cream-colored wooden frame divided into a 3x4 grid (12 panes) of pale greenish, frosted glass. The top is capped with a flat matching horizontal trim. The mesh is clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures, standing flat on the floor without an extra pedestal.
blind.from_above: A simple narrow beige/peach horizontal rectangular bar with slightly rounded corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.2 times taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7 ft tall), and roughly 3.5 to 4 ft wide.
